name: ghostpaw-souls
description: Local cognitive identity engine with traits, behavioral evidence, and revision history.
long_description: Local cognitive identity engine with traits and behavioral evidence. Stores data in a local SQLite database.

db_path.title: Database path
db_path.description: Path to the local SQLite database.

tools.name: search_souls
tools.description: Search shards by content using full-text search, or list pending shards with optional filters.

tools.name: review_souls
tools.description: List all active souls, run the maintenance cycle, or check crystallization readiness.

tools.name: inspect_souls_item
tools.description: Get the full profile, rendered identity block, and optionally the evidence report for a single soul.

tools.name: observe_soul
tools.description: Deposit behavioral observations (shards) for one or more souls, or reveal previously sealed shards.

tools.name: refine_soul
tools.description: Add, revise, revert, or reactivate traits; cite shards to traits; stamp attunement.

tools.name: level_up_soul
tools.description: Validate, execute, or revert a level-up plan for a soul — consolidating traits, promoting knowledge into essence, and incrementing the generation.

tools.name: manage_soul
tools.description: Create, update, retire, or awaken a soul.
